confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence. Hostel and hotel anchors are lower confidence because Pantai Cenang prices vary widely and July is low season. The FX value (0.6955, 15 Oct 2026) was not confirmed on the RBA page itself. Search snippets and third-party sites put mid-October AUD/USD at about 0.692 to 0.696, so verify it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Malaysian and southern Thai island tourist towns (for example Penang and Phuket/Krabi), adjusted to Langkawi's Pantai Cenang resort-strip pricing and converted from MYR at roughly 0.21 to 0.24 USD. July is low season, so accommodation anchors are not peak-season rates.
